The six courses

Each course pairs short lessons with one practical lab. Courses marked In development have a published outline only; none is for sale until it opens.

Build AI agents that do real business work: accounting, administration, customer service, sales and marketing, connected to the tools you already use.

How every course works

Worked examples

The professional academies begin with complete examples and make the reasoning behind good decisions visible.

Guided practice

Scaffolds fade as learners progress—from annotated examples to structured tasks and independent work.

Retrieval and review

Low-stakes questions prompt recall; review revisits important concepts. Model answers and rubrics make improvement specific.

Research-informed updates

The academies cite primary research and standards, record review dates and receive versioned updates as evidence changes.

What is open and what is planned

0 of 6 courses are open. All six are in development. A course page that says In development shows the intended lessons and lab, and the dates are not fixed. To hear when one opens, use the request button on its page. No Intellica credential is issued for this academy; an open course issues a completion certificate under its published rule.

Looking for the technical tracks? See the Software Architecture Academy and the Cyber Security Academy.
